roads.name: Kolob Terrace Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 68 curves in 15.9 miles.
About 3 miles in the middle are tamer.
The 5 miles at the north end are tamer.
A big elevation change: 4,505 to 7,993 ft, with 4,271 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 85°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 25 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.19 g.

roads.name: Red Hills Parkway
words: Sweeping and steady: 16 curves in 4.5 miles.
The curves flow straight into one another.
From 2,835 to 3,210 ft, with 739 ft of up and down along the way.
Built up in places.
23 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 101°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library.
